skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to develop applications and computer systems in real-world scenarios.
Analyze problems in the field of Computer Science, from requirement analysis to implementation.
Evaluate the effectiveness and feasibility of solutions, and propose and evaluate methods to optimize system performance and reliability.
Proficient in applying skills to create effective solutions for real-world problems in the field.
Effectively collaborate and work in teams to promote creativity and progress in solving complex problems.
Demonstrate the ability to communicate and solve problems in real-world environments through presentations and discussions, and receive and evaluate feedback to improve product and process quality.
Set specific goals, plan actions, and take necessary steps to achieve goals during the thesis project.
Take responsibility and make appropriate decisions at different stages of the project, including topic selection, data collection, result analysis, and report completion.
Complete and professionally present the report, demonstrating the student's ability to self-learn and self-manage during the research and implementation of the thesis project.
